Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: In the final step (Step 4), the Planner incorrectly stated the release date of the film "Aami" as "9 February 2008". The WebSurfer agent had previously retrieved accurate information stating the release date was "9 February 2018". The Planner failed to verify this date against the gathered data, introducing a factual error that led to the logically incorrect conclusion that Bitch Slap (2009) was more recent than Aami (which was erroneously cited as 2008).
